name: War-Awoken Hell's Time (Weapon Skill)
effects:
Single-target Fire/NE piercing ranged hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Fire Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if there are 0-1/2+ allies with Attach Fire
WS Blue: [Dualcast Fire, Instant Fire & Weakness Damage +30%] for 3 turns to user
WS Gold: [Dualcast Fire, Instant Fire & Weakness Damage +30%] for 2 turns to all allies
